operator.text:
Plan for Bandwidth:
  Radio: Retevis C62 2501R0621100415 as Retevis C62/C2 (radios/c62.yaml), firmware stock-1.2-20250922, DSP image stock
  Bench: k0ret, receiver rtlsdr, transmitter hackrf, calibration assumed of 2026-10-20
  2m: 146.580 MHz (to receiver 58.4 dB, from transmitter 58.5 dB)
  70cm: 445.975 MHz (to receiver 58.0 dB, from transmitter 58.3 dB)
  Modes: fm
  Transmit tests (first): attenuator chain from the radio to the rtlsdr
  Receive tests (then; you'll be asked to move it): attenuator chain from the hackrf to the radio
  Tests (14):
